best_other_* excludes Global-CS? No: it includes Global-CS, all OVO variants and MRBB; excludes only SOUP and Static-SMOTE
notes: Proposed = SOUP (Similarity Oversampling and Undersampling Preprocessing); other variants OVO SO / OVO SU also introduced. SMOTE baseline = Static-SMOTE (Fernandez-Navarro et al. 2011): iteratively picks smallest class and oversamples with standard SMOTE treating non-selected classes as majority; iterations = number of classes (p.3). Classifiers evaluated: J4.8, PART, k-NN (k=3); J4.8 used as first reported. Metrics: G-mean, average minority, F-score; G-mean per-dataset tables only for J4.8 in paper. Other classifiers' per-dataset results are on web page www.cs.put.poznan.pl/mlango/publications/soup.html (as printed; not fetched). Table 5 (p.10) also gives per-dataset G-mean for Static-SMOTE and baseline with J4.8; baseline column not used. Static-SMOTE not included in Table 8 ranking. Text claim p.1 abstract: 'competitive with the most popular decomposition ensembles and better than specialized preprocessing techniques for multi-imbalanced problems'.
